# Accesserty UI Kit

> A framework-agnostic library of 15 accessibility-first Web Components with zero runtime dependencies and WCAG 2.2 AA as a design target. Automated and targeted browser checks are not complete conformance or screen-reader verification. Supports plain HTML and configured Vue, React, Angular and Nuxt integrations via a single JS file; SSR registration remains client-only.

## Key Links

- Repository: https://github.com/Accesserty/UI-Kit
- Component demos: demo/index.html
- Full API reference: demo/*.html (one file per component)
- Interactive playground: demo/playground.html

## Project Structure

- `src/components/` — Source for all 15 custom elements (one .js file each)
- `src/css/` — Design system CSS (cascade layers: basic-variables, tokens-variables, components)
- `src/accesserty-ui-kit.js` — Bundle entry point (imports all components)
- `demo/` — Human-readable documentation with live examples and CSS variable tables
- `test/` — Browser-based unit tests using @web/test-runner and @open-wc/testing
- `dist/` — Build output: `accesserty-ui-kit.js` and `accesserty-ui-kit.min.js`

## Components

### au-accordion
Tag: `<au-accordion>`, `<au-accordion-item>`
Attributes (au-accordion): exclusive, data-text-exclusive-hint
Attributes (accordion-item): open, heading-level (1–6; default 3), no-region
Properties: open (boolean getter/setter), exclusive (on au-accordion)
Events: au-toggle (detail: { open })
Events describe actual connected state changes, including programmatic updates and sibling closures; same-value writes do not repeat events. Exclusive mode affects direct item children only and normalizes initial/inserted state to the first open item. Nested groups are independent. Native heading buttons support Enter/Space and normal Tab navigation; collapsing focused content returns focus to its header. Heading/sub slots must be non-interactive. Panel visibility is immediate and inert when closed. Plain deferred scripts and pre-definition Boolean properties work; framework registration remains client-only.
Form-associated: No
CSS variables: 15+ (--au-accordion-heading-*, --au-accordion-content-*)

### au-breadcrumbs
Tag: `<au-breadcrumbs>`
Attributes: items (JSON array), separator, aria-label, aria-labelledby, label, data-link-title-prefix, data-link-title-template (`{text}`, `{index}`)
Properties: items (getter/setter), separator (getter/setter)
Pre-registration items/separator assignments are replayed through the accessors. Items accepts an array, JSON string or single item object; rendering requires client registration. SSR integrations serialize the items attribute and register client-side; internal links are not server-rendered. Links use native navigation, not framework router events. Translation retains link focus; a removed/revoked focused link returns focus to the navigation landmark.
Events: none
Form-associated: No
CSS variables: 8 (--au-breadcrumbs-*)

### au-card
Tag: `<au-card>`
Slots: heading, media, content, footer
Only named slots are projected, in that order; no default slot. The card adds no role, tabindex, automatic heading semantics or custom events. Native child controls retain forms, reset and event behavior. render() is idempotent and retains the shell/slots/focus. Default block/min-inline-size/wrapping styles respect hidden; consumers own media sizes, content semantics, themes and focus styling.
CSS Parts: au-card-container, heading, media, content, footer
Parts refer to the container and slot elements; style assigned content through consumer selectors. Real Next/Nuxt/Angular fixtures retain server host/content nodes and native event/form behavior, with client-only registration. These are not screen-reader results.
Form-associated: No
CSS variables: 0 (styled via ::part())

### au-carousel
Tag: `<au-carousel>`
Attributes: aria-label, aria-labelledby, data-text-roledescription, data-live-template, data-item-fallback, data-dot-template, data-text-prev, data-text-next, data-text-pagination, data-text-instructions, data-icon-prev, data-icon-next; per slide (direct child): data-title
Localization templates: data-dot-template, data-live-template, data-item-fallback support `{title}`, `{current}`, `{total}`
Content model: each direct child element is one slide (author-defined native HTML); one pagination button per slide, named + positioned; responsive slides-per-view via @container
Properties: current (getter/setter)
current is a zero-based DOM property, not an attribute; numeric strings/fractions normalize to a bounded integer, invalid/non-finite inputs become 0, empty is -1. Pre-definition property assignment is supported when slides exist at upgrade. Stable slide element identity preserves the selected slide and dot focus across translation/reordering; new nodes are new identities.
Methods: slideTo(index), refresh() (re-read slide titles after a runtime/locale change; also automatic via MutationObserver)
Events: slide-change (detail: { index, total, title })
Changed navigation/current writes and settled scrolling emit; refresh/translation/reordering are silent. Boundary arrows remain focusable aria-disabled controls and do not repeat events. Scrolling uses the track start edge in LTR/RTL without scrolling outer containers. Named wrapper references external labels across Shadow DOM; fallback naming is plain text. Forced-colors outlines and a non-color current-dot ring remain visible; dots wrap at narrow widths. Off-screen slides remain readable/tabbable; there is no autoplay or tabpanel model.
Form-associated: No
SSR: extends HTMLElement — register client-side only (e.g. Nuxt *.client plugin); not importable in Node
CSS variables: 17 (--au-carousel-gap, --au-carousel-visible, --au-carousel-dot-*, --au-carousel-button-*, --au-carousel-controls-gap)

### au-checkbox
Tag: `<au-checkbox>`
Attributes: name, value, checked, disabled, required, label, aria-label, aria-labelledby
Properties: checked (getter/setter), disabled (getter/setter)
Events: change (detail: boolean), focus, blur
Form-associated: Yes (setFormValue: value when checked, null when unchecked)
CSS variables: 14+ (--au-checkbox-*)

### au-dropdown
Tags: `<au-dropdown>`, `<au-dropdown-item>`
Attributes (au-dropdown): data-text-trigger
Attributes (dropdown-item): value
Properties: isOpen (getter/setter on au-dropdown)
Events: selected (detail: { value }) on au-dropdown-item
Activation: one selected event per click/Enter/Space, including after reconnection; translated text/value updates are silent and retain focus.
Keyboard: open(index) focuses immediately; arrows/Home/End navigate owned items across containing shadow roots; Escape restores trigger focus and Tab leaves using browser keyboard preferences.
Form-associated: No
CSS variables: 11 (--au-dropdown-menu-*, --au-dropdown-item-*, --au-dropdown-focus-shadow-*)

### au-file-upload
Tag: `<au-file-upload>`
Attributes: accept, multiple, name, disabled, required, label, max-files, max-size-mb, max-total-size-mb, msg-drop-text, msg-remove-text, msg-remove-file-label, msg-added, msg-removed, msg-required, msg-type-error, msg-size-error, msg-count-error, msg-total-size-error (file-upload uses the msg- prefix; other components use data-text-)
Localization templates: msg-remove-file-label and msg-removed support `{fileName}`; msg-added supports `{count}`; msg-size-error supports `{fileName}` and `{maxSize}`; msg-count-error supports `{fileName}` and `{maxFiles}`; msg-total-size-error supports `{maxTotalSize}`
Properties: value (getter/setter: File[])
Methods: handleFiles(files), removeFile(file), checkValidity(), reportValidity()
Events: change, remove-file (detail: File)
Form-associated: Yes (ElementInternals FormData with actual File entries)
Default trigger: native button named by label; a custom trigger should be a named button type=button. Disabled fields/fieldsets block picker/drop/removal and omit submission without losing selection. Validation focuses a visible region and shows inline errors. Drag/drop handling is scoped to the component. Without multiple, selection is capped at one; remove before replacement. Picker limits default to 5 files, 5MB each and 20MB total; invalid limits use defaults and zero is valid. Extensions/MIME matching is case-insensitive; same name/size duplicates are ignored. The controlled value setter copies File entries, bypasses picker limits, and emits no change. Removal emits remove-file then change once; reset is silent. Translation retains remove-button identity. Pre-registration value assignments survive deferred loading. Client-only registration is required for SSR; File values cannot be serialized as an HTML attribute.
CSS variables: 20+ (--au-file-upload-label-*, --au-file-upload-area-*, --au-file-upload-delete-*, --au-file-upload-file-list-*, --au-file-upload-trigger-focus-outline-*)

### au-input
Tag: `<au-input>`
Attributes: type, name, value, placeholder, required, disabled, readonly, label, aria-label, aria-labelledby, min, max, step, pattern, autocomplete, inputmode, maxlength, minlength, list, data-size (small|large), data-layout (vertical), data-clear, data-clear-label, id
Properties: value (getter/setter), disabled, required, readonly (all getter/setter), validity, validationMessage, willValidate
Methods: focus(), clear(), suggest(val), checkValidity(), reportValidity()
Slots: prefix, affix
Events: input, change (bubbles, composed)
Form-associated: Yes
CSS variables: 22 (--au-input-wrapper-bg, --au-input-label-*, --au-input-padding-*, --au-input-text-*, --au-input-border-*, --au-input-bg, --au-input-focus-shadow-*, --au-input-invalid-shadow-*, --au-input-clear-*, --au-input-small-*, --au-input-large-*, --au-input-container-*)

### au-pagination
Tag: `<au-pagination>`
Attributes: data-total, data-current-page, data-pager-count, data-page-size, data-page-size-options, data-layout, data-text-* (localization)
Localization attributes: data-text-total-pages-prefix, data-text-page, data-text-total-items-suffix, data-text-per, data-text-first, data-text-prev, data-text-next, data-text-last, data-text-go, data-text-goto, data-text-pagination-label, data-text-page-size, data-text-page-announcement (`{page}`)
Properties: pageSizeOptions (getter/setter), layout (getter/setter), totalPages (getter), pagers (getter)
Events: page-change (detail: page number), page-size-change (detail: size)
Form-associated: No
CSS variables: inherits --au-btn-* from button styles

### au-radio-group
Tags: `<au-radio-group>`, `<au-radio>` (slotted children)
Attributes (au-radio-group): disabled, direction (vertical), aria-label, aria-labelledby, label
Attributes (au-radio): value, checked, disabled, label
Properties: value (getter — currently selected), disabled (getter/setter)
Events: change (detail: { value })
Form-associated: Yes (au-radio-group)
CSS variables: 12 (--au-radio-content-gap, --au-radio-input-*, --au-radio-label-*)

### au-rating
Tag: `<au-rating>`
Attributes: value, max, labels (comma-separated), name, show-score, score-info, disabled, readonly, aria-label, data-text-rating, data-text-star (`{value}`, `{max}`), data-text-score (`{value}`, `{max}`, `{scoreInfo}`)
Properties: value, max, labels, name, showScore, scoreInfo, disabled, readonly (all getter/setter)
Events: change (detail: { value: number })
Form-associated: Yes
CSS variables: 12 (--au-rating-gap, --au-rating-star-*, --au-rating-focus-*, --au-rating-label-*, --au-rating-score-*)

### au-switch
Tag: `<au-switch>`
Attributes: name, value, checked, disabled, label, aria-label, aria-labelledby, on, off
Slots: default (label text). `label` provides fallback label text when no slotted label is supplied.
Properties: checked (getter/setter), disabled (getter/setter)
Events: change (detail: boolean — checked state)
Form-associated: Yes (setFormValue: value when checked, null when unchecked)
CSS variables: 17 (--au-switch-gap, --au-switch-padding-*, --au-switch-container-gap, --au-switch-input-*, --au-switch-inner-*, --au-switch-focus-shadow-*)

### au-tabs
Tag: `<au-tabs>`
Children: elements with role="tabpanel" (auto-detected via slot)
Localization attributes: data-text-tab (`{index}` fallback tab label), data-text-badge-label-prefix
Properties: selectedIndex (getter/setter)
Events: tab-change (detail: { index, label })
Form-associated: No
CSS variables: 26 (--au-tabs-*, --au-tabpanels-*, --au-tab-panel-*, --au-tab-badge-*)

### au-textarea
Tag: `<au-textarea>`
Attributes: value, placeholder, name, rows, cols, disabled, readonly, required, maxlength, minlength, label, aria-label, aria-labelledby, id
Properties: value (getter/setter), disabled, readonly (getter/setter), validity, validationMessage, willValidate
Methods: checkValidity(), reportValidity()
Events: input, change (bubbles, composed)
Form-associated: Yes
CSS variables: 15 (--au-textarea-label-*, --au-textarea-container-*, --au-textarea-padding-*, --au-textarea-text-*, --au-textarea-border-*, --au-textarea-bg, --au-textarea-focus-shadow-*, --au-textarea-invalid-shadow-*, --au-textarea-readonly-*)

### au-tree
Tags: `<au-tree>`, `<au-tree-node>` (auto-created from data)
Attributes (au-tree): show-checkbox, aria-label, aria-labelledby, data-text-node, data-text-toggle (`{label}`)
Properties (au-tree): data (getter/setter — JS object tree), toggleLabel (getter/setter), fallbackNodeLabel (getter/setter), toggleLabelTemplate (getter/setter)
Events: change (on au-tree, when checkbox state changes)
Data: use sibling-unique id values to retain nodes, focus and state across object replacement; otherwise identity uses the original objects. Labels are plain text. Optional lang sets node language.
State: leaf checked and branch expanded fields are reapplied on data assignment; omitted fields retain local state. Disabled branches block checkbox actions/cascades but allow navigation and expansion. Parent checks aggregate enabled children.
Events: one change.detail.checkedNodes array for an actual check operation; data/locale updates are silent and do not mutate input objects. Assign data as a DOM property, not JSON markup.
Form-associated: No
CSS variables: 30+ (--au-tree-*, --au-tree-node-*, --au-tree-node-checkbox-*, --au-tree-node-toggle-*)

## Technical Stack

- Runtime: Vanilla Custom Elements v1, Shadow DOM (open), ElementInternals API
- CSS: Custom Properties, Cascade Layers, CSS Nesting, oklch color space
- Build: Vite 6 + rollup-plugin-terser
- Testing: @web/test-runner 0.18, @open-wc/testing 4, Chromium
- Node.js: 20+ required for development

## Design Decisions

- No framework dependency — components must work from a `<script>` tag alone
- Shadow DOM mode is always `open` (accessible to testing and DevTools)
- CSS variables control all visual properties; no inline styles
- Accordion panel visibility is immediate; reduced motion disables header/icon transitions
- `formAssociated = true` + ElementInternals for native form participation (no hidden inputs)
- Events always use `{ bubbles: true, composed: true }` to cross Shadow DOM boundaries
- `generateId()` uses `crypto.getRandomValues()` with `Math.random()` fallback for SSR safety
- `customElements.define()` is guarded with `typeof customElements !== 'undefined'` for SSR safety
